title: Your coach
lead: Ask about your work, your numbers or your next step. Your coach reads your week map, reps and progress before every answer.

newChatAsk.title: Start a new chat?
newChatAsk.body: This conversation will be cleared. Your week map, reps and plan stay as they are.

empty.title: What would you like to work on?
empty.lead: These questions come from your own week. Pick one or ask your own, by text or voice.

composer.label: Message your coach
composer.placeholder: Ask about your week, your plan or your next job
composer.keys: Enter sends, Shift and Enter starts a new line.
composer.micHint: Hold the mic while you talk, then let go to send.
composer.release: Let go to send. Slide away or press Esc to cancel.

voice.label: Voice message, {time}
voice.denied: Your browser blocked the microphone. Allow it in the address bar, or type your question.
voice.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Type your question instead.
voice.too_short: That was too short to hear. Hold the mic while you talk.
voice.failed: We couldn't read that recording. Try again, or type your question.

errors.stopped: You stopped this before the coach answered.
errors.no_speech: We didn't catch any words. Try again a little closer to the mic.
errors.transcribe_failed: We couldn't write down your voice message.
errors.budget: The coach can't answer right now. Your message is kept, so try again later.
errors.rate_limited: Too many messages from this network right now. Wait a minute, then send again.
errors.coach_cap: You've sent {cap} messages today. Your coach is back tomorrow.
errors.coach_busy: Your coach is still answering your last message.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Your message is kept, so send it again.
errors.voice_too_long: Voice messages can be up to a minute long.
errors.voice_invalid: We couldn't read that recording. Try again, or type your question.
errors.coach_required: Your personal coach comes with Max.
errors.load: We couldn't open your coach. Nothing is lost.

sees.title: What your coach knows
sees.fromMedian: Based on the US median pay for the job
sees.fromSalary: Based on the salary you entered
sees.toggle: What your coach knows about your week

locked.tagLong: A real answer from your coach, written from your week map
locked.loading: Your coach is answering a first question from your week
locked.title: Your personal coach comes with Max
locked.body: Ask anything about your work by text or voice. Your coach reads your week map, reps, skills and 90-day plan before every answer and points you to the next step.
locked.price: {month} a month, or {yearMonthly} a month billed yearly

noMap.title: Your coach starts from your week map
noMap.body: The coach answers from the tasks of your own week. Mapping it takes about two minutes, from a job title or your resume.
